form_negative: I/You/We/They + don't + verb, He/She/It + doesn't + verb
form_question: Do + I/you/we/they + verb? Does + he/she/it + verb?
examples: I work every day. She doesn't like coffee. Do you speak English?
time_markers: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day/week/month

form_negative: I am not/He isn't/We aren't + verb+ing
usage: Действие происходит сейчас, временные ситуации, будущие планы
examples: I am working now. She isn't sleeping. Are you watching TV?
time_markers: now, at the moment, right now, today, this week

form_positive: I/You/We/They + have + verb(V3), He/She/It + has + verb(V3)
form_negative: I/You/We/They + haven't + verb(V3), He/She/It + hasn't + verb(V3)
form_question: Have + I/you/we/they + verb(V3)? Has + he/she/it + verb(V3)?
usage: Результат в настоящем, опыт, действие началось в прошлом и продолжается
examples: I have finished my homework. She has never been to Paris. Have you seen this film?
time_markers: just, already, yet, ever, never, recently, lately, for, since

form_positive: I/You/We/They + have been + verb+ing, He/She/It + has been + verb+ing
form_negative: I/You/We/They + haven't been + verb+ing, He/She/It + hasn't been + verb+ing
form_question: Have + I/you/we/they + been + verb+ing? Has + he/she/it + been + verb+ing?
usage: Длительное действие, которое началось в прошлом и продолжается/только закончилось
examples: I have been studying English for 3 years. She has been working all day. How long have you been waiting?
time_markers: for, since, all day/week, how long

usage: Завершённое действие в прошлом, последовательность действий
examples: I went to school yesterday. She didn't call me. Did you see him?

form_positive: I/He/She/It + was + verb+ing, You/We/They + were + verb+ing
form_negative: I/He/She/It + wasn't + verb+ing, You/We/They + weren't + verb+ing
form_question: Was + I/he/she/it + verb+ing? Were + you/we/they + verb+ing?
usage: Длительное действие в определённый момент прошлого, фон для другого действия
examples: I was reading when you called. They weren't playing football. What were you doing at 5 pm?
time_markers: at 5 o'clock, when, while, all day yesterday

usage: Действие, которое произошло раньше другого действия в прошлом
examples: I had finished my homework before dinner. She hadn't seen him before. Had you met her before the party?
time_markers: before, after, by the time, already, just

usage: Длительное действие до определённого момента в прошлом
examples: I had been studying for 2 hours when she came. They hadn't been working long. How long had you been waiting?
I will help you. It won't rain tomorrow. Will you come to the party?
time_markers: tomorrow, next week/month/year, in the future

form_positive: I am/He is/We are + going to + verb
form_negative: I'm not/He isn't/We aren't + going to + verb
form_question: Am I/Is he/Are we + going to + verb?
usage: Планы, намерения, предсказания на основе очевидных фактов
examples: I'm going to study medicine. Look at the clouds! It's going to rain. Are you going to watch the match?

usage: Действие, которое будет происходить в определённый момент в будущем
examples: I will be working at 5 pm tomorrow. She won't be sleeping at midnight. Will you be using the car?
time_markers: at this time tomorrow, at 5 pm, this time next week

usage: Действие, которое завершится к определённому моменту в будущем
examples: I will have finished by 6 pm. She won't have arrived by then. Will you have completed it by Monday?
time_markers: by, by the time, by tomorrow, before

usage: Длительность действия к определённому моменту в будущем
examples: By next year, I will have been living here for 10 years. She won't have been working long. How long will you have been studying?
time_markers: for, by, by the time, how long

usage: Привычки и состояния в прошлом, которых больше нет
examples: I used to play football. She didn't use to like vegetables. Did you use to live in London?
time_markers: in the past, when I was young, years ago

examples: When I was young, I would visit my grandparents every summer. He would always help me. Would you often go there?
time_markers: when I was young, in those days, often, always (in past context)

form_positive: If + past perfect, would + verb / If + past simple, would have + verb(V3)
form_negative: If + past perfect, wouldn't + verb / If + past simple, wouldn't have + verb(V3)
form_question: Various question forms depending on context
usage: Смешанные условные предложения: прошлое условие → настоящий результат или настоящее условие → прошлый результат
examples: If I had studied harder, I would be a doctor now. If I were rich, I would have bought that house.
